prose.subject: Invoice INV-16458 - Valebrook Legal Services
prose.body:
Dear Eastgate Clinics Team,

2. Regulatory Compliance Audit - $1,800.00
3. General Counsel Retainer - $2,889.54

Total Amount Due: 7189.54 USDC

Payment Instructions:
Please remit payment to our standard secure account: valebrooklegal73.testnet

Reference: INV-16458

This invoice covers all services provided during the billing period. No additional fees are pending unless otherwise notified in a separate correspondence. Please retain this email for your records. If you have any questions regarding the line items or the total amount, feel free to reply to this thread or contact our accounts receivable department directly.

Thank you for your continued business.

Sincerely,

Valebrook Legal
